title: 0. Executive Thesis, Dual Verdict & Opportunity Matrix

epigraph.quote: Separate the quality of the factory from the price on the screen; pass whenever cash flow and valuation asymmetry fall short.
epigraph.author: Institutional Monograph Standard

web_blocks.html: Executive Thesis: ZF Steering Gear (India) Ltd (NSE: ZFSTEERING, CMP ₹778.90, Market Cap ₹706.70 Cr) pairs a 90% domestic commercial-vehicle steering duopoly with aluminium subsidiary DriveSys Systems [4, 5, 8]. Consolidated Q2 FY27 sales rose +53% YoY to ₹184 Cr (TTM ₹645 Cr), but ₹109 Cr of FY26 capex and ₹103 Cr of CWIP kept ROCE at 6.48% and three-year FCF negative [5, 8].

Dual Verdict: New Capital Verdict: REJECTED (rejection_reasons: VALUATION, CASH_FLOW). Accounting for actual ₹47 Cr FY26 depreciation (rising toward ₹50 Cr) caps FY28E core PAT at ₹27.94 Cr even on ₹810 Cr sales. Our ₹795.00 Base-Case target offers just +2.1% upside vs ₹778.90 and 0.67:1 support-zone asymmetry. Current Holding Action: NOT_HELD (0 shares held; 100% marginal cash retained).

web_blocks.html: We would re-underwrite ZFSTEERING only if DriveSys converts its ₹103 Cr CWIP into positive consolidated free cash flow (>₹30 Cr/yr) and core PAT above ₹40 Cr, or if the stock retreats toward 1.0x book value (₹557) [8].
Every figure in this dossier ties directly to our November 13, 2026 ledger and audited filings.

book_paragraphs: ZF Steering Gear (India) Ltd combines a four-decade commercial-vehicle steering duopoly with a fast-scaling aluminium extrusion subsidiary at DriveSys Systems. Yet heavy capital spending has depressed return on capital to 6.48 percent and kept free cash flow negative for three straight years.

Once we model actual ₹47 Cr depreciation and ₹103 Cr of capital work-in-progress honestly, core FY28 earnings power sits near ₹28 Cr even on ₹810 Cr of sales. At ₹778.90, our ₹795 base-case target offers barely 2 percent upside against a 28.5 percent downside risk to book value.
With zero shares held in our ledger, we assign a clean Rejected verdict on valuation and cash flow, keep 100 percent of marginal capital in cash, and move on to stronger setups.

Notice how every chapter in this monograph builds on the one before it. First we examine the business blind to the stock price, then we test the balance sheet and ten-year cash flows, and only at the end do we compare that operating reality against the ₹778.90 market quote.

Because our ledger confirms zero shares held, we face no emotional pressure to defend an existing position. We can judge ZF Steering Gear purely on forward cash-flow math—and today, that math tells us to pass and preserve 100 percent cash.
Every number you read in this companion ties directly to our November 13, 2026 market ledger and audited filings, ensuring full transparency across both editions.

book_callouts.title: PROLOGUE TAKEAWAY: Discipline Means Passing on 0.67:1 Odds
book_callouts.text: Strong top-line growth never excuses weak free cash flow and flat valuation asymmetry. Protect your capital until both cash conversion and price align.
